name: org-standards
description: PeoplesHR organization standards for Claude Code. Ships the phx-product-context skill for grounding answers about PeoplesHR module behaviour in the product documentation held in WeKnora, and the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. The hrm-deployment-script, hrm-notification, phx-debugger and hrm-configuration-document skills moved to the dev-kit plugin in 3.0.0; the phx-sql-standards-review skill and the phx-dbexplorer MCP server moved to the dba-kit plugin in 4.0.0.
